name: replay
invariant: Replay is deterministic: folding `apply` over the same History from the same initial Omega always produces an equal State, regardless of how many times it is replayed.
explanation: `apply` is a pure function of (State, Event) alone -- no wall-clock reads, no ambient globals -- so replaying the same finite event log twice must produce byte-for-byte identical State values. This fixture checks that property directly rather than asserting it only in prose. Full round-trip serialize/deserialize-then-replay (the stronger 'same digest after going through a wire format' claim from the tracking issue) is not yet exercised here; see Phase B ('Specify serialization and canonical output') for that follow-up.
